BiblicalUsage: Morash is a possession, a heritage. Babylon will be a possession for the bittern and pools of water, Job's purposes are broken off and the thoughts of his heart are his possession no more, and on Mount Zion there shall be deliverance, and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe possession runs both ways in Scripture. God gives a heritage, and He takes one away, and the difference is faithfulness.
